Fresh Ginger Paste

Zesty, Aromatic & Warming

  • Net Weight: 250g

  • Description: Prepared from chosen ginger roots, this paste offers a sharp, zesty punch and warm flavor to your dishes. Perfect for traditional Indian curries, stir-fries, teas, and marinades.

  • Key Highlights:

    • Zesty, sharp, and aromatic taste

    • 100% natural ginger flavor

    • Eliminates chopping and grating time

    • Excellent warming spice for curries and teas

Fresh Garlic Paste

Thick, Smooth & Ready to Use

  • Net Weight: 250g

  • Description: A rich, smooth paste made from fresh garlic cloves. Designed for maximum convenience, it delivers robust garlic aroma and authentic taste straight into your curries, sauces, and marinades.

  • Key Highlights:

    • Thick and smooth texture for easy blending

    • Authentic fresh-garlic aroma

    • Saves time on peeling and crushing

    • Ideal for curries, marinades, and gravies

Nilansh Gold Kala Jira (Black Cumin)

Rooted in Tradition, Crafted with Care

  • Net Weight: 150g

  • Description: Premium quality Kala Jira packed with essential aromatic oils, Omega-3s, and powerful antioxidants. Known in traditional wellness for aiding digestion, boosting immunity, and promoting overall heart health.

  • Key Highlights:

    • Supports digestion and metabolic health

    • Rich source of antioxidants and Omega-3s

    • Helps boost immunity naturally

    • Premium glass jar packaging for fresh aroma

Pure Desi Ghee

Product of Solan Hills — Pure & Aromatic

  • Net Weight: 1Ltr

  • Description: Slow-crafted from pure milk fat in the pristine hills of Solan, this Desi Ghee features a classic golden granular texture and rich homemade aroma. Perfect for drizzling on rotis, cooking, or making traditional Indian sweets.

  • Key Highlights:

    • Traditional granular (danedar) texture

    • Rich aroma and authentic mountain taste

    • High smoke point, ideal for cooking and frying

    • Source of healthy fat and energy

Dehydrated Garlic Powder

Pungent, Aromatic & Essential

  • Net Weight: 500g

  • Description: Made from premium garlic cloves dehydrated at optimal temperatures, this powder offers intense flavor without the tedious peeling and chopping. Adds quick depth and aroma to marinades, sauces, soups, and seasonings.

  • Key Highlights:

    • Pungent, aromatic, and 100% natural

    • Ready to use with zero preparation required

    • Blends smoothly into gravies, rubs, and marinades

    • Long shelf life with full flavor retention

ND Fresh Fruit Drink Concentrate

Double the Refreshment

  • Net Weight: 500g

  • Description: A fruit-infused drink concentrate crafted to give you instant hydration and cooling refreshment. Perfect for hot days, family gatherings, or an everyday quick refresher full of zesty citrus flavor.

  • Key Highlights:

    • Delivers instant cooling refreshment

    • Zesty, sweet fruit flavor profile

    • Easy to mix and prepare in seconds

    • Great energy boost for warm days

Artisan Berry & Fruit Jam

Spreading Smiles, One Jar at a Time

  • Net Weight: 500g

  • Description: Made with wholesome fruits and berries, this artisan jam is packed with delicious fruit chunks and natural sweetness. A delightful breakfast companion that turns ordinary toasts, waffles, and pancakes into a sweet treat.

  • Key Highlights:

    • Made with real fruit chunks and wholesome berries

    • Delicious balance of natural sweetness and tartness

    • Handcrafted artisan recipe

    • Perfect breakfast spread for all ages

Forest Dried Mushroom Mix

Forest’s Bounty — Rich & Umami

  • Net Weight: 500g

  • Description: A carefully curated mix of sun-dried mountain mushrooms that bring a deep, savory umami flavor to your kitchen. Perfect for enhancing soups, gravies, curries, and gourmet dishes with rich texture and natural goodness.

  • Key Highlights:

    • Rich in natural umami flavor

    • Versatile for curries, soups, and gourmet recipes

    • Carefully dehydrated to lock in nutrients and aroma

    • 100% natural forest produce

Pure Turmeric Powder

The Golden Spice — Earthy, Nutritious & Pure

  • Net Weight: 500g

  • Description: Sourced for its high natural curcumin content, this bright golden turmeric powder delivers rich aroma, vibrant color, and powerful health benefits. An essential spice that brings authentic flavor and antioxidant power to every meal.

  • Key Highlights:

    • High in natural curcumin and antioxidants

    • Pure, unadulterated, and potent

    • Enhances immune health and supports wellness

    • Essential spice for daily Indian cooking

Pure Apricot Oil

Naturally Pure Mountain Care

    • Cold Pressed & 100% Natural

    • Packed with Omega-3 & Vitamin E

    • Light, non-sticky formula for natural skincare

Pure Wild Apricot Oil

Purely Sourced From The Mountains

  • Key Highlights:

    • 100% Organic & Cold Pressed

    • Naturally rich in Vitamin E & essential nutrients

    • Zero added chemicals or artificial preservatives

Nilansh Gold Protein Mix

Tradition Meets Nutrition — पौष्टिकता का अनमोल तोहफा

    • Rich blend of barley, chickpeas, almonds, and cashews

Authentic Himalayan Lal Rajma

Experience the Foothills — Nutritional. Pure. Authentic.

  • Description: Hand-picked from the foothill farms of the Himalayas, this Lal Rajma cooks up tender and creamy, absorbing flavors deeply to make delicious, authentic kidney bean curries.

    • Hand-picked for uniform quality and quick cooking

    • High in protein, iron, and dietary fiber

    • Authentic flavor profile straight from Himachal Pradesh

High Plant Protein & Digestive Wellness.

The Power of Tradition. Uncompromising Purity.

    • Cools the body naturally and boosts energy

    • Zero preservatives or artificial additives

Traditional Unfiltered Ogla Flour (Buckwheat / Kuttu)

बिना छाना हुआ — Pure Himalayan Heritage

    • Unfiltered (बिना छाना हुआ) for maximum fiber and nutrition

Traditional Unpolished Koda Grain / Flour

पाएँ परंपरा का स्वाद, शुद्धता का भरोसा।

  • Net Weight: 250g

  • Description: Koda (Kodo Millet) is a traditional Himalayan super-grain celebrated for its low glycemic index and high dietary fiber content. Carefully processed by Suyash Food Industries to maintain traditional taste and complete purity, it is an excellent gluten-free alternative for healthy daily meals.

Premium Unpolished Kala Chawal (Black Rice)

The Ancient Power of Kala Chawal — Authenticity & Health in Every Grain.

पाएँ परंपरा का स्वाद — शुद्ध, अनपॉलिश लाल चावल।

Net Weight: 500g

Description: Sourced from traditional Himalayan regions, Suyash Food Industries Unpolished Red Rice retains its natural bran layer, giving it a rich, nutty flavor and superior nutritional value. Rich in antioxidants and fiber, it is ideal for preparing hearty khichdi, porridges, or daily meals.

Key Highlights:
